Guide.title: A quick start.
Guide.subtitle: Start an example, compare routes, then explore simulated changes. Claims remain unavailable.

screen.title: Check and compare routes
screen.description: Press Check route and wait for the comparison. Shortest route uses distance; Alternative route (simulation) uses authored costs. Then continue to navigation.

explore.title: Explore changes on the timeline
explore.description: Use Next or Previous to compare three fixed snapshots. See which road costs and routes change. Reset demo returns to the example. No GPS tracking or weather forecast is involved.

evidence.title: Understand Claims status
evidence.description: Claims is a preview of a future workflow. Evidence storage, token issuance and verification are unavailable. Platform penalty reversal is not guaranteed.

Guide.weather: Weather: model-derived current conditions from Open-Meteo, with a model timestamp. Use device location by permission or select Bogor manually on Dashboard.
Guide.simulation: Flood simulation: synthetic roads and authored costs. It is separate from weather and contains no measured street flood conditions.
Guide.safety: An available route is no safety guarantee. Do not enter floodwater to test this prototype.

start.title: Start a trip demo
start.description: From Dashboard, choose Screen a Route. On Pre-order, press Try Example Trip to fill your three stops. Change locations is optional.

frame.meaning: One fixed, fictional snapshot of road costs.

shortest.meaning: A path minimizing authored synthetic distance.

alternative.meaning: A path minimizing arbitrary demo cost units, without validated flood risk.

unknown.meaning: Flood measurements are unavailable. An unchanged cost does not mean a dry or safe road.

Experimental.title: Experimental fixture replay
Experimental.label: Simulated / Unverified Dataset
Experimental.limitations: Source provenance is unknown. No verified road coverage, live flood monitoring, calibrated risk, or safety guarantee.
Experimental.error: Fixture data is unavailable or invalid. Check your connection and retry.
Experimental.preview: Experimental coordinate preview — schematic, unverified CRS
Experimental.legend: Blue solid: distance baseline. Orange dashed: stored-weight route. Arrows: directed edges.
Experimental.changed: Weighted route changed from the previous frame.
Experimental.unchanged: Weighted route unchanged from the previous frame.
Experimental.unreachable: Unreachable in this directed network. Choose different nodes.
Experimental.unitsCaveat: Source fields only: depth assumed metres; signed velocity components assumed m/s, orientation unknown. No calibrated physical interpretation. Costs do not close edges.
